purpose: You Were Shaped for Serving God

group.title: Accepting Your Assignment
group.question: What is holding me back from accepting God’s call to serve him?

group.title: Shaped for Serving God
group.point: I was shaped for serving God.
group.question: In what way can I see myself passionately serving others and loving it?

group.title: Understanding Your Shape
group.question: What God-given ability or personal experience can I offer to my church?

group.title: Using What God Gave You
group.question: How can I make the best use of what God has given me?

group.title: How Real Servants Act
group.point: I serve God by serving others.
group.question: Which of the six characteristics of a real servant offers the greatest challenge to me?

group.title: Thinking Like a Servant
group.point: To be a servant I must think like a servant.
group.question: Am I usually more concerned about being served or finding ways to serve others?

group.title: God’s Power in Your Weakness
group.point: God works best when I admit my weakness.
group.question: Am I limiting God’s power in my life by trying to hide my weaknesses? What do I need to be honest about in order to help others?
